decision: Can the CC operator safely inspect and route one bounded content capsule without changing content?
liveConsumer: The CC content operator using the project content-runtime commands.

gates.evidence: The user explicitly requested beginning Phase 0 on 2026-07-15.

preconditions.evidence: The capsule owns no content paths and produces terminal output only.
codex.md §M and the content protocols were read before implementation.

doneWhen: Runtime configuration and all capsules validate.
Preflight returns GO without writing files.

stopConditions: The command attempts to edit content or generated app artifacts.
The worktree is main/master instead of an isolated branch.
The configured model or reasoning effort differs from the capsule.
expectedArtifacts: A deterministic preflight report printed to stdout.
A deterministic runtime status report printed to stdout.
